comments.author: askhl
comments.body: Good to get this fixed.  Let's use the existing integer division operator `range(len(atoms) // 3)`

comments.author: askhl
comments.body: This looks a little bit grubby, should we use `molecule('H2O')` from `ase.build` and clean up?  That seems like a more useful pointer for someone who wants to build boxes of water.  But maybe the geometry needs to be set to something very specific, in which case the code itself should probably provide a shortcut for retrieving the correct geometry.

comments.author: askhl
comments.body:
since this is not a volume (given the final part of the line), we should name it e.g. `length`.

Maybe encourage programmatic practices instead of hardcodedness, say, `atoms.get_masses().sum() / units.mol`.  Probably the other factor still has to be hardcoded

comments.author: askhl
comments.body: Thanks a lot!  Also very useful to plot the atoms
